arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,b.request_id,(select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b

select c.booking_id,c.status,c.amount_cents,c.idempotency_key,b.status bs,b.amount_cents ba,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=c.booking_id) hold from charges c left join bookings b using(booking_id) where b.status="pending" or b.client_reference is not null
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","holds","bookings")

select substr(c.booking_id,5,6) b,c.state,c.amount_cents,b.status bs,b.amount_cents ba,b.client_reference cr,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=c.booking_id) hold from charges c left join bookings b using(booking_id) where b.status<>"confirmed" or b.client_reference is not null
select substr(b.booking_id,5,6) b,b.status,c.state,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op from bookings b join charges c using(booking_id) where b.status<>"confirmed"
